faq: 这是日本官方 LoveType 测试吗？
这是费马独立编写的娱乐版，只参考公开的字母框架。题目、算法呈现、解读和视觉均由本站独立提供。
32 道题怎么算？
四组各 8 题，每次给所在组的一端加 1。L/F 是发起或回应，C/A 是接受或提供照顾，R/P 是实际或浪漫起点，O/E 是弹性安排或明确意图。
为什么我有好几个组合？
同组如果选成 4:4，就保留两个字母。取四组保留字母的全部组合，数量在 1–16 之间。
能不能看两人是否合适？
不能。选择由题目和你参考的情境决定，不预测伴侣、关系走向，也不评估依恋或心理健康。
结果和指南都免费吗？
全部计数、所有符合组合和 16 篇指南都免费，答题也不需要注册。
分享时会公开自己的回答吗？
复制公开入口只含题名和链接。个人 PNG 含计数与代码，不含逐题答案，由你主动保存或分享。
zh.formula: 32 题分四组，每组 8 题二选一。每次给该组所选的一端加 1。多数端保留一个字母，4:4 保留两个，最后列出四组字母的全部组合。
zh.boundary: 本题用自己的原创场景讨论当时的意愿。四字母只是这些选择的组合，不能判断人格、依恋、伴侣合适程度或关系成败。

faq: 這是日本官方的 LoveType 測驗嗎？

分享圖卡和公開連結各有什麼？

zh-TW.formula: 32 題分四組，每組 8 題二選一。每次替該組一端加 1，較多的一端保留；4:4 就兩邊都留，列出四組字母的所有組合。
zh-TW.boundary: 費馬另行編寫原創生活情境。結果只整理當次作答，不是伴侶配對、人格分類、依附評估或關係預測。

en.facts: FermatMind’s Love Type Test uses 32 original paired choices and takes about seven minutes. It is free without registration. Results show counts on four axes and all four-letter combinations supported by the answers. Sixteen public guides are available without answering. A personal PNG can show the counts and codes, while the copied public link reveals no personal result. Full guides are free to read.
en.intro: When either person could suggest a plan, would you open the conversation or respond first? Work through 32 paired situations and see how you chose around initiative, care, practical or romantic concerns, and how clearly to define the plan.
deliverables: Eight choices feed each pair. A 4:4 split keeps both letters.
Read every compatible combination for free
There can be one to sixteen codes. Each has a complete guide you can also open as a public page.
Save a personal PNG or copy a public link
The browser can make a card with four pairs of counts and all compatible codes, without item answers. The public link carries none of the result.
interpretations: One side leads on every axis: LCRO
L/F is 7:1, C/A is 6:2, R/P is 5:3, and O/E is 5:3. That leaves one letter per axis and one code.
Two axes tie: four possible codes
L/F is 4:4, C/A is 6:2, R/P is 4:4, and O/E is 3:5. The guides are LCRE, LCPE, FCRE, and FCPE.
Every side is retained, so all sixteen codes appear. Display order is for navigation.

lcro: Start with an easy plan you can adjust
You may like to propose a plan and ask for a little care around the details.
You suggest coffee, ask for somewhere close, and leave the time flexible.
lcre: You may like to initiate and know what kind of time or attention to expect.
You suggest dinner, say you want a chance to talk, and ask for a time that fits your shift.
lcpo: You may like to propose a warm moment and leave room for plans to change.
You suggest hearing some music and ask for company on the walk, with no fixed route.
lcpe: Say what the gesture means to you
You may like to start an affectionate plan and hear how the other person sees it.
You bring up celebrating an anniversary and ask what would make it feel special to both of you.
laro: Start a plan and help it along
You may like to make a practical suggestion and offer useful support while details remain open.
You suggest shopping together and bring bags, leaving the start time for later.
lare: Make a clear plan with care built in
You may like to propose a practical arrangement and tell both people what they can count on.
You suggest dinner, check when the other person needs to leave, and write down the agreed time.
lapo: You may like to create a warm moment and leave room for both of you to change it.
You offer to bring drinks for a walk and let the route depend on the day.
lape: Start something meaningful and check intentions
You may like to initiate a romantic plan while asking how the other person understands it.
You invite someone to hear music and check what would make the night enjoyable for them.
fcro: Accept the opening and check practical details
You may like to respond first and ask for an arrangement that makes space for your needs.
When someone suggests a walk, you ask to meet at a nearby gate and decide how far to go later.
fcre: Respond once the invitation is clear
You may like someone else to start and find it easier to reply when the plan makes sense.
When invited out, you ask whether it is a casual catch-up or time for a particular conversation.
fcpo: Follow a warm invitation at your own pace
You may like to receive an affectionate offer and leave its details open.
You accept an invitation to hear music and ask them to walk with you first.
fcpe: Ask what a welcome gesture means
You may like to respond to warmth and ask what the other person intended.
You thank them for a gift and ask whether they were hoping to celebrate something together.
faro: Join a practical plan and lend a hand
You may like to respond with concrete help while leaving time for changes.
When someone suggests cooking, you offer to bring ingredients and leave the serving time open.
fare: Listen to the plan and offer one commitment
You may like to help once the plan and expectations are clear.
Once you know the time and size of a dinner, you offer to book a table.
fapo: You may like to respond to a romantic idea with a little help and some room to improvise.
When invited for a walk, you bring spare headphones and leave the route undecided.
fape: Join a meaningful plan with a clear reply
You may like to respond warmly once you have heard what the invitation means.
When invited to celebrate an anniversary, you ask what they want to do and offer to make a playlist.

faq: Is this the official Japanese LoveType quiz?
FermatMind made this independent entertainment quiz. Public framework terms provide context. The questions and guides are written for this edition.
What are the four pairs?
L/F is initiating or responding, C/A receiving or giving care, R/P practical or romantic starting points, and O/E flexible arrangements or explicit intentions.
Why did I get several codes?
Any 4:4 split retains both letters. The result lists all combinations of the retained letters, between one and sixteen.
Can the result match me with a partner?
No. It summarizes choices in these scenarios and cannot establish compatibility, attachment, personality, or relationship outcomes.
Are all guides free?
Yes. You can see all counts and eligible codes without registering or paying, and all sixteen guides are public.
What does sharing reveal?
A personal PNG can show the four pairs of counts and the compatible codes without item answers. Copying the public entry shares only the title and link.
en.formula: Answer eight paired choices on each of four axes. Each choice adds one to its side. The higher side is retained, and a 4:4 split keeps both. The report lists every possible combination of the retained letters.
en.boundary: These independently authored scenarios describe what you chose this time. The codes do not classify personality, measure attachment or mental health, match partners, or predict relationship success.
